info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Interest Charges API
Return the data for all InterestCharges

params.name: bill_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Bill. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the InterestCharge records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter InterestCharge records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: exclude_ids[]
params.description: Array containing *InterestCharge* identifiers that should be excluded from the query.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter InterestCharge records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of InterestCharge records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter InterestCharge records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

items.docs: Outlines the parameters, optional and required, used when requesting the data for all InterestCharges

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the InterestCharge.
